answer: Treat capital as a river with a memory: every unit of credit records a birth-stamp of the block and the exact path it travelled through previously verified holders. Fresh sybil keys cannot mint clean money, because any transfer from a cohort born in the same narrow window inherits a shared provenance tag. If a hundred new wallets all draw from one dune-fresh mint, the tag clusters and their weight is deferred until each proves a distinct downstream history. Money with a fabricated lineage washes out like pale violet dye in moving water.
